about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Medical equipment supply, biomedical technical services, periodic maintenance, and corporate consulting since 2015.
about.storyTitle: 10+ Years of Excellence in Biomedical Engineering & Healthcare Technologies
about.storyP1: Founded in 2015, Cebeci Medikal began by providing medical equipment, technical maintenance, and biomedical engineering support. Incorporated formally in 2021 as CBC Medikal, we now serve public and private healthcare institutions across the region with uncompromised reliability.
about.storyP2: From supplying state-of-the-art systems for operating theaters, ICUs, and laboratories to performing ISO and TSE certified calibration and repairs, our certified biomedical engineers ensure uninterrupted clinical safety.
about.missionDesc: To enhance patient care and hospital workflow by providing world-class medical devices and certified biomedical technical services with transparent pricing and continuous technical support.
about.visionDesc: To be the most trusted and preferred healthcare technology partner in medical device procurement, certified refurbished equipment, and advanced biomedical engineering services.
about.timelineSubtitle: A decade of steady, trust-driven growth and technical innovation.
about.t2015Desc: First steps into healthcare engineering with technical maintenance and device calibration.
about.t2021Desc: Corporate restructuring, expanding procurement network and hospital partnerships.
about.tTodayDesc: Supplying 100+ healthcare institutions with certified new and refurbished systems.
about.tFutureDesc: Biomedical engineering innovation and international healthcare technology partnerships.
